_comment: Phase 2B-2 native-reconstruction golden fixtures. Frozen deterministic outputs of the native pipeline (propose_zones -> compose_container_graph[native] -> census -> projection -> containment -> fidelity) for bottle/jar/tube with a first-pass concept (no structured record). A change to any value means the native reconstruction geometry/policy changed and must be reviewed. Every fixture asserts zero decorative rasters, live text present, all placements contained, deterministic projection, and a three-state fidelity of MEASURED_PASS with no failures (name emitted; record-only axes UNMEASURED). ANNOTATED, never rewritten (§AZ0(u)): the base fidelity has read UNMEASURED_BLOCKING since VQR-2A, and since §BH50(f)(5) (2026-09-16) the motif fidelity reads UNMEASURED_BLOCKING too — the family passes and a pass never outvotes the unmeasured density, position, coverage and continuation axes; failures stay []. [His answer after test day finding 3, 2026-09-30, (4) round: a tube's width is its round diameter, its front and back its flat face, π/2 of it, and it is drawn that wide — the tube's entry recomputed with the tests' own functions (zones, their hashes, the motif's paths, the wrap), every other entry byte-identical.] [His review of 127, 130, 131 and 132, 2026-10-15, C (8): "No empty grey blocks in the files (131's base bottom)"] a surface panel that would hold only a placeholder — its tinted field, its caption and "INFO · INCI · CODE" or "BATCH —" — is no longer drawn; its surface keeps its (empty) group, so surface_groups stand: live_text bottle 7 -> 5, jar 6 -> 5, tube 10 -> 5; vector_paths bottle 9 -> 8, jar 10 -> 8, tube 10 -> 8; the motif runs' vector_paths bottle 59 -> 58, tube 38 -> 36 (the jar's wrap holds its motif, drawn as before), recomputed with the tests' own functions; every other value byte-identical.] [His last goal before the pitch, 2026-10-16, Step 2: "the hero is never lost: caps and closures"] every capped form draws the parting line where its cap meets its body (closure-join-line): one vector path more for bottle, jar and tube, with and without their motif.
